items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Uh-huh. Yeah, there's a lovely picture of you and Braud together in the Foster book. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: (unintelligible). All right. don't used to say, aw, don't let that guy play, I said why? Oh man that guy can't play. He'll criticize it. You play some day. (inaudible), give up my bass and I walk away, let him play.
Uh-huh. Yeah, there's a lovely picture of you and Braud together in the Foster book.
